steps.name: Automated close orchestration and cutoff
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Cutoff, posting lock and checklist distribution run automatically from the close calendar, with the close manager handling only readiness exceptions.
inputs: Subledger status (AP, AR, fixed assets, payroll)

steps.name: Rule-based journals and allocations
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Template-driven accruals, prepayment releases and allocations are generated by rule and posted; the accountant prepares and evidences only judgment-based provisions and estimates.
outputs: Period-end journals posted with supporting evidence

steps.name: Continuous intercompany matching and settlement
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Intercompany matching runs continuously through the period rather than at close; only unmatched items reach the intercompany team for resolution with counterparties.

steps.name: Risk-rated automated reconciliation
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Low-risk accounts auto-certify on a rules match; medium and high-risk accounts are reconciled and certified by the accountant per the risk rating in the reconciliation policy.

steps.name: Consolidation and eliminations
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Trial balance, currency translation, intercompany elimination and minority-interest processing run on the consolidation engine and are validated against entity submissions.

steps.name: Controller review and adjustment
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Analytics flag anomalies against expectations and prior period; the controller investigates the flagged items, posts documented adjustments and signs off.

steps.name: Automated reporting package assembly
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Statements, variance schedules and KPI summaries assemble automatically from signed-off results; the reporting accountant writes commentary and releases the package.

disposition_mapping.rationale: SMOKE FIXTURE. Close initiation is orchestrated by the platform rather than run manually by the close manager.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Journal preparation narrows to judgment-based entries; template-driven entries are generated by rule.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Allocations are merged into the rule-based journal generation step, sharing the same engine and posting run.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Intercompany matching moves from a close-window activity to a continuous one.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Reconciliation is retained as a distinct certified control, with automation scoped by risk rating.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Consolidation and eliminations carry over substantially unchanged.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Management review is narrowed to analytics-flagged anomalies rather than a full read-through.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Package assembly is automated; the reporting accountant retains commentary and release.
